description: Expedited appeal certification form with no AcroForm: ruled underscore lines under a question are one multiline input named by it ("patient:" names the second, the line that wraps the sentence), and the provider’s signature line is an input named "Provider’s Signature:" (#281, F7). Its question "Is the appeal for a service that the patient has not yet received?" has two drawn boxes, Yes and No: a pair of radios in a group named by the question (#281).
